features.name: Copilot Studio Platform
features.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is the recommended platform from Microsoft for building, managing and customizing agents and Copilots, particularly when connecting business systems and applications.

features.name: Agent Builder
features.description: A light experience in Copilot Studio for Microsoft 365 Copilot users to build agents with just a few prompts, requiring no deep knowledge of connected applications.
caveats: requires light user access to Microsoft 365 Copilot

features.name: Power Platform Connectors
features.description: Copilot Studio has access to 1400 plus connectors from Power Platform for connecting to various data sources and applications.

features.name: MCP Connector
features.description: A dedicated connector in Power Platform for integrating Model Context Protocol servers with Copilot Studio agents, as shown in the MCP session.

features.name: Workflow Designer
features.description: A new unified canvas in Copilot Studio for agentic automation that is AI-first and natural language driven, with support for human-in-the-loop workflows.

features.name: Human-in-the-Loop Approvals
features.description: Copilot Studio supports advanced approval scenarios with markdown format, and when a flow waits for approval, it automatically resumes and keeps full context.

features.name: Business Central Agent Publishing to Microsoft 365 Copilot
features.description: Agents built in Copilot Studio for Business Central can be published and surfaced in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, calling Power Platform connectors and MCP server endpoints behind the scenes.

features.name: Declarative Agent Manifest
features.description: When an agent built in Copilot Studio is published, a declarative agent manifest is published to the agent store, making it available in both standalone and Business Central versions of Microsoft 365 Copilot.

features.name: Compliance Agent with Business Central Query
features.description: A Copilot Studio agent that performs full compliance checks across Business Central users, checking each user for compliance status and generating remediation plans.

features.name: Laptop Equipment Order Agent
features.description: A Copilot Studio agent that supports ordering new equipment by creating purchase orders in Business Central while checking if employees qualify for equipment refresh, with approval workflows and MCP tool integration.

features.name: Tool referencing in agent instructions
features.description: Ability to directly reference defined tools and subagents in agent instructions using slash notation rather than text definitions. This makes agent tool selection more reliable.

features.name: Knowledge sources in agents
features.description: Agents can incorporate knowledge from multiple sources including public websites, SharePoint, and company-specific resources to inform agent decision-making.

features.name: MCP server connection for Business Central
features.description: Integration with MCP servers to connect agents to Business Central, allowing agents to view and modify purchase orders, items, and lists within Business Central.

features.name: Power Automate connectors in Copilot Studio
features.description: Agents can use connectors from Power Automate or standard Business Central connectors as alternatives to MCP connections for agent tooling.

features.name: Agentic flows for orchestration
features.description: Predefined workflows that agents can invoke to orchestrate repetitive, multi-step processes like creating purchase orders, without requiring agents to handle each step independently.

features.name: Human approval in agentic flows
features.description: Agentic flows can include human approval steps that pause execution until approval is received. Approval can be sent via Teams and can request additional inputs before resuming.
caveats: requires explicit instruction for agent to notify user of wait

features.name: Agent testing and debugging in Copilot Studio
features.description: Agents can be tested within Copilot Studio UI with visibility into all tool calls and return values for debugging purposes. Testing performance is slower than production due to initialization overhead.
caveats: MCP connections slow during testing and initialization
performance slower in testing than production

features.name: Agent activity monitoring
features.description: Copilot Studio provides monitoring tabs to track agent activity including which channel was used, last step, and status of agent sessions. Useful for identifying issues like hanging approvals.

features.name: Agent evaluation framework
features.description: Copilot Studio provides evaluation capabilities to test agents against multiple test methods including tool use, custom tools, keyword matching, similarity matching, and exact match assertions.
caveats: evaluations run manually in UI, do not run automatically

features.name: Automated evaluation workflows
features.description: Power Automate workflows can trigger agent evaluations on a schedule using the Copilot Studio evaluate agent connector, allowing recurring or event-based evaluation runs without UI interaction.

features.name: Evaluation APIs for agents
features.description: Microsoft provides APIs for agent evaluation that can be called from outside Copilot Studio workflows, enabling integration with external systems and custom evaluation orchestration.

features.name: Multi-agent orchestration with session inheritance
features.description: Multiple agents can work together in orchestrated flows, with child agents inheriting conversation sessions and receiving passed inputs from master agents. Useful for separating concerns and handling tool overflow.
caveats: only one agent should talk to user at a time
child agents may have broader permissions than master agent

features.name: Conversation history and input handling in multi-agent flows
features.description: Multi-agent flows support passing conversation history between agents and can define different actions on input completion when calling child agents.

features.name: Agent security warnings and lifecycle management
features.description: Copilot Studio warns about sharing scope and missing skills. Power Platform admin center controls lifecycle management, deployment, and role-based access.

features.name: Agent analytics and session reporting
features.description: Analytics in Copilot Studio and Power Platform to create reports, measure session engagement, view feedback, and track resolution status.

features.name: New Copilot Studio experience
features.description: Updated Copilot Studio experience released recently with skills and Microsoft IQ rates for M365 suite integration.
features.status_evidence_quote: a few days ago a new Copilot Studio experience uh has been has been released that you can you can preview and use.

features.name: M365 Copilot chat in Business Central
features.description: M365 Copilot chat coming to Business Central with agents. Users can talk to agents directly within Business Central.
features.status_evidence_quote: M365 Copilot chat coming to Business Central. We are working in a way that it comes with the agents, right?

features.name: First-party agents customization
features.description: First-party agents available out of the box with ability to customize some parts coming soon.

features.name: Agent Runtime in Business Central
features.description: Agent runtime for agents built inside Business Central with access to pages and experiences, plus human in the loop support.
caveats: Pages and experiences available inside Business Central

features.name: Copilot Studio for API and Power Automate integration
features.description: Copilot Studio as preferred approach for building agents when APIs or Power Automate flows already exist, with connector integration.

features.name: Agent Runtime conversational experience plan
features.description: Plans for Agent Runtime to be available in conversational experience, currently only Copilot Studio offers this.
caveats: Currently only Copilot Studio offers conversational experience

features.name: Business Central limited usage rights on Power Platform
features.description: Business Central includes limited usage rights on Power Automate, Power Apps, Power Pages, and premium connectors.

features.name: Copilot credit pricing model
features.description: Two billing models for Copilot Studio: credit packs at 25,000 credits per month for 200 dollars, or pay-as-you-go billing.
caveats: Credit packs offer better pricing than pay-as-you-go

features.name: Copilot Studio cost estimator
features.description: First-party agents include a cost estimator interface for calculating pricing based on user count, models, tools, and knowledge sources.

features.name: MCP server access control
features.description: MCP server access depends on configuration settings. Access to specific MCP servers is controlled by administrator configuration.
caveats: No approval process beyond admin configuration
Access limited to configured MCP connections

features.name: Power Platform solution distribution for agents
features.description: Agents can be shipped and distributed through Power Platform solutions and published to AppSource for monetization.
features.status_evidence_quote: Today you today you will ship it through a Power Platform solution, right?
caveats: Monetization through AppSource and Copilot credits margin

features.name: Agent credit margin for ISVs
features.description: ISVs receive margin from Copilot credits when distributing agents through Power Platform.

features.name: Agent access from Business Central chat
features.description: The goal is to integrate Copilot chat within Business Central so MCP agents that users have access to can be interacted with there, the same way as in M365 chat.
caveats: requires Business Central license for APIs

features.name: Business Central license requirement for agent APIs
features.description: Users accessing agent APIs within Business Central will need a Business Central license.
caveats: scope of little license not defined
